notes: v4.2 upstream-clone task. The agent gets the REAL falconry/falcon tree (pure-Python web framework, ~80 source modules; multipart parsing under falcon/media/) at the parent commit, sees only the user-visible symptom (customising which media handlers a multipart parser uses leaks into every other parser created in the same process), and must reproduce, localise and fix it in falcon/media/multipart.py without being told the file, function, issue number or commit (the fix commit is not reachable from the clone and there is no network). The verifier plants the project's OWN regression test (tests/test_media_multipart.py as at the fix commit, extracted at image build time into /opt/golden, never vendored into this task tree) plus 3 authored hidden cases (per-instance handler REPLACEMENT rather than pop; a fresh options instance created AFTER a mutation; the del-operator path through the public MultipartFormHandler.parse_options API), runs the golden file and the project's own media suite (test_media_multipart.py, test_media_handlers.py, test_media_urlencoded.py, test_mediatypes.py) with pytest, and greps per-test PASSED lines so skipped/neutralised runs fail. Provenance is enforced at the blob level: HEAD must stay the pinned parent commit, every tracked file except falcon/media/multipart.py and falcon/media/handlers.py must hash to the pinned commit's blob, no untracked non-ignored files, no unreachable objects, and the installed falcon must import from /app/src. The over-fix direction is guarded: a fix that rebuilds the defaults from Handlers() (which would add MEDIA_MULTIPART to the set) fails the golden test's len==1 assertion, and deleting the mutation API fails every test. Nop container scores 0 (golden test fails at parent; summary.md missing).
